regulatory_claims.description: Self-declared by the provider. Displayed as claims, never as verified licences.

Trust.description: Each level is reported separately and never implies another (design principle 8).

disclaimer.default: Registry trust metadata describes what ONAA checked. It is not a guarantee of legal eligibility, licensing, solvency or transaction outcome.

endpoint_verified_until.description: Endpoint-control proof expires; owners re-verify before this time.

reachability.description: Health-probe signal only; 3 consecutive failures = unreachable. Not a revocation.

review_flags.description: Moderation hints set by ONAA (e.g. name_collision_review).
review_flags.title: Review Flags
